items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Kimmel had a $500, $400 paramount, gold... Banjo player. He had an ordinary $150 vega phone banjo.

ctx.x: Yeah, put some of them and spread it down.

See, he told me to get them one. His is straight, so he ain't got no pressure on the head. Because the banjo he got is a real good banjo. A vega, you can't beat him for tone. That's the best. Kimmel had a $500, $400 paramount, gold, and I don't know if you know, Emmy O'Reilly.
